nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P73 – CBRN protection of critical civil infrastructure
nphi.with: SCK CEN (lead); Security and Freedom for Europe (SAFE); Landau Network Fondazione Volta
nphi.summary: RIVM assessed risks to Jordan's water infrastructure and delivered COVID-19 support (training, e-learning, NGS course, equipment) in Lebanon, Iraq and Jordan.

nphi.title: National Inventory of Dangerous Pathogens in North Africa
nphi.with: CRDF Global (US State Dept ISN/CTR funding)
nphi.summary: As a CRDF Global subcontractor, RIVM adapted its Uganda pathogen-inventory software and method, then held consultations with Jordan and Tunisia.

nphi.title: SCAPHeR – Applied public health research capacity in GHPP regions (GHPP)
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Social Services Namibia; Jordan Center for Disease Control (JCDC); Fiocruz
nphi.summary: Builds applied public health research capacity among public-sector staff and communities of practice in the WHO AFRO and EMRO regions, with Fiocruz contributing. It follows on from the earlier GHPP project CARe.

nphi.title: RKI–EMPHNET Memorandum of Understanding
nphi.with: Eastern Mediterranean Public Health Network (EMPHNET, Amman; regional scope)
nphi.summary: A strategic MoU signed in Berlin in October 2024 covering training, research, outbreak response, laboratory management, IPC, AMR, emergency preparedness and support for establishing NPHIs in the Eastern Mediterranean.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 110 – One Health Secure
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); CSIC; IRD; IZS Teramo; AVIA-GIS
nphi.summary: EU CBRN Centres of Excellence project in which Institut Pasteur and Italy's ISS, with veterinary and research partners, help Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel countries prepare for climate-sensitive vector-borne diseases through One…

nphi.title: German KfW financing (up to EUR 39 million) to build Jordan CDC
nphi.actor: Jordan National Center for Disease Control and Prevention (JCDC)
nphi.with: KfW Development Bank
nphi.summary: A 2023 financing agreement under which KfW funds a permanent building, laboratories, equipment and staff training for Jordan's new national CDC to strengthen epidemic and pandemic preparedness.

nphi.title: SAPHIR – public health intelligence training and EIOS noise-reduction pilots
nphi.with: WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; WHO EMRO
nphi.summary: RKI and the WHO Hub train pilot countries in public health intelligence and develop AI-based noise reduction for the EIOS platform.

nphi.title: EMPHNET FETP exchange: Pakistan residents hosted at IEDCR Bangladesh
nphi.actor: Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research (IEDCR)
nphi.with: FETP Pakistan; EMPHNET
nphi.summary: Two FETP Pakistan residents spent two weeks at IEDCR in Dhaka (scientific writing, surveillance site visits, emergency operations simulation, DHIS2/QGIS/R/PHEOC training) with Bangladeshi fellows and mentors.

nphi.title: Kuwait CDC – EMPHNET needs assessment for a national FETP
nphi.with: EMPHNET; WHO EMRO
nphi.summary: The Kuwait Centre for Disease Control worked with EMPHNET and WHO EMRO on a needs assessment to inform setting up a national FETP.

nphi.title: Saudi Public Health Authority – EMPHNET programme on MERS and Hajj/Umrah
nphi.with: EMPHNET
nphi.summary: The Saudi Public Health Authority worked with EMPHNET on a field-epidemiology programme focused on MERS and Hajj/Umrah health issues.

nphi.title: National emergency response capacity assessment and workplan with Yemen's MoPHP
nphi.with: Yemen Ministry of Public Health and Population (MoPHP); environmental and animal health sectors
nphi.summary: September 2026 workshop in Aden using the US CDC Capacity Assessment Tool (CAT 2.0) to assess Yemen's emergency coordination, rapid response teams and PHEOC and draft a national action plan with One Health coordination.

nphi.title: 7-1-7 target and Early Action Review training of trainers for Palestine
nphi.with: Palestinian Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: National training of trainers in Amman (September 2026) with the Palestinian Ministry of Health on the 7-1-7 timeliness target and early action reviews, starting an initial Palestinian 7-1-7 implementation plan.

nphi.title: Specialised field epidemiology cohorts on respiratory viruses in Lebanon and Pakistan (PHEP-RV)
nphi.with: Lebanon Ministry of Public Health Epidemiological Surveillance Program; Lebanese Red Cross; Ministry of Agriculture; Sindh provincial health institutions / FELTP Pakistan
nphi.summary: EMPHNET-supported 2026 cohorts: Lebanon's FETP cohort 7 (21 residents) and a Sindh, Pakistan cohort (26 participants) trained in respiratory virus surveillance and response.

nphi.title: EMPHNET support to Sudan's health system and MoU with Blue Nile National Institute for Communicable Diseases
nphi.with: Federal Ministry of Health Sudan; Blue Nile National Institute for Communicable Diseases (University of Gezira); national EPI
nphi.summary: August 2025 mission that arranged reopening of EMPHNET's Khartoum office, followed up joint immunisation projects and signed an MoU with the Blue Nile National Institute for Communicable Diseases on training, research and knowledge…

nphi.title: EMPHNET – Somalia MoH renewed MoU incl. support for a National Institute of Health
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Human Services, Federal Republic of Somalia
nphi.summary: October 2025 renewal of the EMPHNET–Somalia MoU, with recommendations on workforce and laboratory needs assessment, One Health activities and support to develop the concept and framework for a Somali National Institute of Health.

nphi.title: JCDC – Yemen public health laboratories cooperation talks
nphi.with: National Center of Public Health Laboratories, Ministry of Public Health and Population, Yemen
nphi.summary: A Yemeni national public health laboratory delegation met JCDC in 2024 to discuss drawing on Jordanian expertise in surveillance and laboratories.

nphi.title: EMPHNET – AFENET inter-regional memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: African Field Epidemiology Network (AFENET)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in June 2024 linking the Eastern Mediterranean and African field epidemiology networks for joint workforce training, preparedness and laboratory collaboration, cross-border deployment of field epidemiologists and knowledge…

nphi.title: Jordan NEIDC – US CDC memorandum of understanding
nphi.actor: Jordan National Epidemiology and Infectious Diseases Center (NEIDC / Jordan CDC)
nphi.with: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
nphi.summary: MoU signed in 2023 during a Jordanian NEIDC delegation visit to US CDC, aimed at strengthening Jordan's public health infrastructure and response plans for epidemics and other health threats.

nphi.title: EMPHNET FETP exchange: Afghan residents hosted by FELTP Pakistan at NIH Islamabad
nphi.actor: National Institute of Health, Pakistan (FELTP Pakistan)
nphi.with: FETP Afghanistan; EMPHNET
nphi.summary: Two FETP Afghanistan residents visited FELTP Pakistan and the NIH in Islamabad under the EMPHNET exchange scheme (December 2022 to February 2023 reporting period).

nphi.title: EMPHNET FETP exchange: Lebanon FETP leadership visits FETP Tunisia
nphi.with: FETP Lebanon; EMPHNET
nphi.summary: The director and coordinator of FETP Lebanon visited FETP Tunisia under the EMPHNET exchange programme.

nphi.title: EMPHNET FETP exchange: Yemen FETP member hosted by FETP Iraq
nphi.with: FETP Yemen; EMPHNET
nphi.summary: A member of FETP Yemen visited FETP Iraq under the EMPHNET exchange scheme.

nphi.title: EU Initiative on Health Security (2020–2025)
nphi.with: National public health institutes and ministries of health of EU Enlargement and Neighbourhood countries
nphi.summary: DG NEAR-funded €9 million programme through which ECDC built epidemic intelligence, risk assessment, preparedness and field-epidemiology (MediPIET) capacity in 21 neighbourhood and enlargement countries and integrated them into ECDC…

nphi.title: Multi-centre hospital-based surveillance of meningococcal meningitis in Iraq
nphi.with: Iraq Ministry of Health; Iraq Center for Disease Control and Prevention
nphi.summary: GHD|EMPHNET supports Iraq's Ministry of Health and Iraq CDC in hospital-based surveillance of invasive meningococcal disease across 18 hospitals in four provinces, building laboratory capacity.

nphi.title: GOARN in the Eastern Mediterranean: partner institutions and 2019-2020 deployments
nphi.actor: GOARN Eastern Mediterranean partner institutions (incl. NIH Pakistan, Institut Pasteur Tunis, EMPHNET)
nphi.with: National Institute of Health Pakistan; Institut Pasteur du Maroc; Institut Pasteur de Tunis; Institut Pasteur of Iran; EMPHNET; Ministries of Health
nphi.summary: 17 partner institutions from 12 countries support outbreak deployments, e.g. 25 experts to the Larkana HIV outbreak in Pakistan, cholera in Yemen, floods in Iran and measles in Tunisia (2019-2020).

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 075 – MediLabSecure (One Health biological risks in the Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel)
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); IRD; INIA; IZS Teramo; Avia-GIS
nphi.summary: EU-funded network led by Institut Pasteur with Italy's ISS that strengthened laboratories and public health institutions in 22 neighbouring countries to detect and respond to arboviruses and their vectors, including external quality…

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 054 – Medical preparedness and response to CBRN incidents in the Middle East
nphi.with: Sustainable Criminal Justice Solutions (SCJS)
nphi.summary: EU-funded project in which Public Health England and SCJS equipped CBRN training centres, trained master trainers and developed Arabic/English SOPs for medical CBRN response in Iraq, Jordan and Lebanon.

nphi.title: Strengthening brucellosis surveillance, diagnosis and control in Iraq
nphi.with: Iraq Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; Central Public Health Laboratory; veterinary laboratory
nphi.summary: An EMPHNET-supported project with Iraq CDC and the Central Public Health Laboratory to set up a tiered brucellosis diagnostic workflow (Rose Bengal, ELISA, RT-PCR) and identify circulating Brucella species in four provinces.

nphi.title: Laboratory biorisk management training for Jordanian laboratory staff (Winnipeg)
nphi.with: Canadian Science Centre for Human and Animal Health (Winnipeg); International Centre for Infectious Diseases; Global Affairs Canada (funder)
nphi.summary: Global Affairs Canada funded biorisk management training at the Canadian Science Centre for Human and Animal Health in Winnipeg, which houses PHAC's NML, for five Jordanian staff who run Canadian-funded biological laboratories in Jordan.

nphi.title: CDC Jordan – MOH and JCDC collaboration
nphi.with: Ministry of Health; Jordan Center for Disease Control (JCDC)
nphi.summary: CDC has worked in Jordan since November 1998 on workforce capacity, data use and surveillance with the MOH; in Sept 2022 a CDC MENA delegation met the newly created JCDC on surveillance, lab information networks and epidemic response…
